hero.title: About Our Club
hero.subtitle: Chartered in 1922, we've spent over a century making Winchester, Virginia a better place for children and families.

overview.title: The Kiwanis Club of Winchester
overview.body1: We are the Kiwanis Club of Winchester, Virginia - a non-profit service club focused on one simple idea: change the world one community and one child at a time.
overview.body2: Chartered in 1922, our club has a long history of raising and distributing funds for the benefit of our community, with a special emphasis on children. Over the decades we've grown into an active group of dedicated volunteers who show up every week - and for every cause.
overview.body3: We meet at noon every Wednesday at the Winchester Moose Club, located at 215 E. Cork St. Guests are always welcome - come see what we're about before you commit.
